units.text: INT. AUCTION HOUSE - CLOAKROOM - NIGHT
Rows of coat hooks, a long counter, brass tickets in a bowl.
Muffled applause through the wall.
A marble clock ticks.
BARONESS ISADORA KELLERMAN-OYE (60s, fur stole, emerald choker) stands at the counter.
HUGO LINDENBAUM (30s, tuxedo, cloakroom attendant's bow tie slightly crooked) holds up a coat.
INSPECTOR FELICITY ANGWIN (40s, dark overcoat) leans against the far wall, notebook open.
Hugo, I gave you the ticket at nine.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Baroness, you gave me a ticket at nine. I assumed it was for the stole.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: The stole is on my shoulders.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Baroness, may I ask what was in the coat?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: A letter.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: A letter, ma'am?
units.name: HUGO

units.text: Hugo, let her answer.
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: A letter from my late husband, to be read aloud this evening at the sale, which is why I was so careful about the ticket.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: I gave it back to a gentleman.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: Which gentleman?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: What gentleman?
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Tall. Beard. Blue ribbon in his lapel.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: That is the auctioneer!
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: He's been on the dais all night.
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: Then it was someone dressed as him.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: Hugo, you gave my husband's last words to an impostor!
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Ma'am, in my defence, he was very convincing.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: Baroness, was the letter in an envelope?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: Cream. Sealed with green wax. My initials in the corner.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: And what did the letter say?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: That is none of your concern.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: It may be of great concern. A man was found in the carriage house this evening. In his pocket, a cream envelope.
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: Dead?
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Yes.
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: A long silence.
Applause through the wall again, rising, then falling away.
Hugo puts down the coat.
Ma'am. I swear I didn't know.
units.name: HUGO

units.text: Of course you didn't.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Baroness, do you know the man?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: No. I never saw him before in my life.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Then why are you crying?
units.name: FELICITY

units.text: Because he has my husband's face.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Felicity closes the notebook.
Hugo picks up the tuxedo coat and holds it out like a shield.
